import os,time,json,pickle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
from planner import plan,resample,PX
from render_plan import metrics

R_OFFSET=float(os.environ.get('R_OFFSET','1.0'))
SPEED=float(os.environ.get('PAINT_SPEED','.025'))
GAIN=float(os.environ.get('TRACK_GAIN','2.5'))

def depth(radius):
 return np.clip(np.log(np.maximum(.4,2*(radius+R_OFFSET)*PX)/1.38)/.1875,.25,13.5)

def generate():
 if not os.path.exists('/app/output/paths.pkl'):plan()
 paths=pickle.load(open('/app/output/paths.pkl','rb'))
 s=Session('/app/instance.json',render=False);p=s.primitives();s.record_start();t=time.time();loaded=None;errors=[]
 for j,stroke in enumerate(paths):
  if loaded!=stroke['color']:
   pos=s.tip_pose()[0].copy();pos[2]=.052;p['move_tip'](pos,speed=.08,settle=3)
   well=s.wells()[stroke['color']]['center_xy']
   p['move_tip']([*well,.052],speed=.18,settle=3)
   p['move_tip']([*well,.025],speed=.05,settle=4)
   p['move_tip']([*well,.052],speed=.08,settle=3)
   assert s.brush_state()['color']==s.wells()[stroke['color']]['name']
   loaded=stroke['color']
  path=resample(stroke['path'],SPEED/.02/PX) # 20 Hz sample spacing in pixels
  # (metres/s)*50 ms converted to millimetres, then pixels
  xy=np.array(s.geo.px_to_world(path[:,0],path[:,1])).T
  xyz=np.c_[xy,.02-depth(path[:,2])/1000]
  pos=xyz[0].copy();pos[2]=.052;p['move_tip'](pos,speed=.18,settle=4)
  p['move_tip'](xyz[0],speed=.025,settle=5)
  for pos in xyz:
   q,ok,err=s.ik(pos)
   if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('ik',j,pos,err))
   qc=s.joint_positions();cmd=qc+GAIN*(q-qc)
   s.step(cmd)
   errors.append((s.tip_pose()[0]-pos)*1000)
  p['hold'](3)
  pos=xyz[-1].copy();pos[2]=.052;p['move_tip'](pos,speed=.06,settle=3)
  if j%20==0:
   print('stroke',j,'/',len(paths),'steps',s.n_steps,'wall',round(time.time()-t,1),'err',np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(errors),axis=0)),flush=True)
   Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/progress.png')
 a=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(a,'/app/output/trajectory.npz',meta={'method':'colour-region inset curves with thin-region connectors','planned_strokes':len(paths)})
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/painting.png');np.save('/app/output/ink.npy',s.ink())
 print('steps',len(a),'strokes',len(s.strokes()),'state',s.state_sha(),'wall',time.time()-t,flush=True)
